data.title: Dependabot: dashboard requirements updated once, watchdog held below 7
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
Two fixes to `.github/dependabot.yml`, from #62 and #63:

- **No duplicate bumps.** The root `pip` entry (`directory: "/"`) also scanned `dashboard/requirements.txt`, so every dashboard bump was proposed twice: #62 by the `/dashboard` entry and #63 by the root one, the same change. The root entry now excludes `dashboard/**`, which the `/dashboard` entry keeps.
- **watchdog held below 7.** Streamlit 1.66.1, the latest release, requires `watchdog<7,>=2.1.5`, so `watchdog==7.0.0` makes the dashboard's install unresolvable (the `dashboard` job of #62 and #63). The `/dashboard` entry ignores watchdog `>=7` until a Streamlit release allows it.

#62 and #63 are closed in favor of this.

data.title: retry summary push when main has moved
data.author: davidlange6
data.body:
Each run of "Process FCC Models" pushes its summary commit back to `main`. If `main` moves during a run, the push is rejected and the run fails. It then leaves no summary and no artifact, and the submission file stays on `main`. This happened to the runs for #7 and #11, which were merged about 25 seconds apart along with #10.

The commit step now rebases on `main` and retries the push up to 5 times, with a growing delay. Runs for different packages touch different files, so these rebases should be clean. A real conflict, such as two versions of the same package merged together, still fails the run after the retries.

Not tested in a real race: that needs two quick merges to `main`. Checked locally that the workflow YAML and the step's bash parse.

data.title: Use the hit time error for the hit time resolution
data.author: jburzy
data.body:
EDM4hep 1.2 stores a time error per tracker hit (key4hep/EDM4hep#528), and DDPlanarDigi now fills it with the digitization time resolution (key4hep/k4Reco#74). CKFTrackingAlg now takes the time resolution of each hit from its time error, for both the 4D CKF measurement and the seeding time cuts. HitTimeResolutions is kept as a fallback for hits without a time error, e.g. files digitized before EDM4hep 1.2. It is no longer required when hit time is used, and the placeholder warning is removed. A hit with neither throws. The time error is read only when building against EDM4hep 1.2 or newer.

cc @madbaron

- SurfaceManager: surfaces of nested detectors (e.g. the subdetectors of a `DD4hep_SubdetectorAssembly`) are no longer entered several times into the "world" and type maps. 

ENDRELEASENOTES

This is a follow-up to #1703, from the same look at the k4Bench reconstruction benchmarks for FCC-ee. While checking the surface map of ALLEGRO_o1_v04 we noticed that "world" has 363,481 entries, although the detector only has 162,979 surfaces.
